title: How generative AI supports human in conceptual design
scope_note: 全文逐页规则筛查＋高相关证据页语义清点；证据链仅保留PDF原句定位，未使用旧表内容。
context_summary: The study investigates how generative AI supports human designers in conceptual design, focusing on novice designers. It compares the effectiveness of text-to-text (ChatGPT) and text-to-image (Midjourney) models in different stages of the design process.
